description: A wallet's claimable ETH from the swap fees of the tokens it launched through CoinFactory (one balance across all of them, held in CoinFactory's RevenueManager), plus each token's fees still waiting in its Flaunch pool: Flaunch pays a pool's fees out only once they pass about 0.001 ETH, so new or quiet tokens show 0 claimable while pendingInPool grows. Read-only.
name: get_creator_rewards
title: Check launch rewards
